from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyIntangibleAsset(BaseModel):
    """Record of intangible assets for a single company from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code if available in the text")
    intangible_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="Ending balance of intangible assets")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元' or 'CNY'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Financial report period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyIntangibleAsset] = Field(description="List of companies found in the provided financial reports")
